changeSet.author: sydorenko
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO module (course_id, title, description, order_index) SELECT c.id, 'Mock Module ' + CAST(v.value AS VARCHAR(10)), 'Module description', v.value FROM course c CROSS JOIN GENERATE_SERIES(1, 10) v WHERE c.title LIKE 'Mock Course %';

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM module WHERE title LIKE 'Mock Module %';
